"Didn't shoot *me*." There is sincere disappointment on her face. This kid was expecting *pandemonium* and release from her mortal coil.

Only the most even-keeled minds in Martinaise.

Most likely your findings will be collected in a report, which will be carefully reviewed by your superiors.
The most awesome, terrible thing...
This is a grave abdication of la responsabilité. A note will be appended to your personnel file.
Please, you're thinking about this too narrowly.
Harry, Harry. You're thinking about this too narrowly.
Good luck. Your report is eagerly anticipated.
Like a committee.
